tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rang bsrung rgyas pa bri tshul shin tu gsal ba bzhugs// na mo ma hā kā lā ya/ mal gyo lo chen sa skya'i bla chen mchog kun dga' snying po snyigs dus gangs can dpal/ sa lo kun dga'i mtshan can 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /brgyud par bcas la gus pas phyag bgyis nas/ /sa skya pa yi chos bsrung kun gyi gtso/ /nag po chen po'i man ngag snying po yi/ /bsrung 'khor zab mo thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /bri thabs ma gab bdag gi gsal bar bri/ /de la rang bsrung 'khor lo rgyas pa bri ba'i thabs bla ma'i gsung bzhin cung zad brjod na/ dbang rjes gnang man ngag sogs thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa/ yi dam chos bsrung gi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ dus khyad par can brgyad gnyis sam dgu gnyis gang rung gza' skar bzang ba la mchod gtor phul te/ bri gzhi gro ga gos dar nag po mgon po'i snyan dar lta bu/ dur khrod kyi ras zhes pa ro ras yin yang / bod na srol chen po med pas/ dpa' bo g.yul du bsad pa'i ro la ras g.yogs pa tsam la byed/ shog bu la'ang rus pas sra shing yi ge sku sogs bri gang bde la/ chag ma yong tsam gyis 'dul lugs legs par byas nas/ bri rdzas zhun chen la mar nag bsres nas sbar ba'i dud pa bsags pa las byas pa'i snag tsha la/ gu gul/ gur gum/ ga pur/ rgya skyegs kyi khandha/ 'byor na rang byung gi me tog mtshal rnams bsres te sbyar bas bri'o/ /de la dang por nang du zlum po lte ba ste/ sku bshom pa'i phyir zlum bskor cung che ba/ de'i mthar gsum rim bskor ba'i phyi ma 'khor lo'i sa sku bshom pa'i phyir che ba bskor/ de'i phyi nas zlum bskor bdun bskor ba'i lnga par chos skyong gi sku bri dgos pa'i phyir cung che ba ste bskor thig yongs gril bcu gcig gi phyi rol du me ri 'bar bas bskor ba bri/ de'i dbus kyi lte bar nag po chen po mi'u thung gri thod gaṇḍi bsnams pa/

sprul pa'i khyung chen shong tsam byung na lnga/ mi shong na gcig steng du/ g.yas g.yon rgyab mdun du bya nag khyi nag ce spyang / mi nag rnams me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba/ deng sang yongs su grags pa ltar bri/ ske rags kyi sbrul ma chad pa gal che ste klu brgyad tshang dgos so/ /de dag gang bri yang bla ma'i man ngag bzhin sa bon gsum dang snying po spel ba bri gsung ba bar gzungs lta bu yin pas/ mgon po'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bris pas dpral pa'i oṃ gyi mthar nag po chen po'i sku yi 'chang ba pa la bsrung du gsol/ ces pa oṃ gyi 'og nas bskor la yig mgo phyi bstan bri/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mthar sa bon gsum dang snying po spel ba yin pas/ hūm̐ gi 'og nas bskor la/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ ces pa yig mgo phyir bstan hūm̐ la bskor te bri/ de'i phyi'i bskor thig dang po'i lte ba'i mu khyud la/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā hūm̐/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen pos 'chang ba pa la gzhan gyi byad kha sbod gtong mnan gtad gzer gsum/ nad gdon bar chad mi mthun phyogs thams cad bsrung shig rakṣa/ ces pas mu khyud khengs par bri/ ma kheng na bskyar nas bri/ mi shong na rakṣa mang po bris la khengs par bya'o/ /bar stong ma las pa gal che/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud gnyis pa la phyogs bzhir gri gug so phyir bstan pa re/ mtshams bzhir thod pa khrag bkang kha phyir bstan pa re bri/ de'i phyi'i bskor thig gsum pa'i mu khyud che ba la 'khor lo rtsibs drug bris pa'i mgon po'i mdun gyi rtsibs dang po la e ka dza ṭi sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi stod g.yogs dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ ral pa'i lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/

zhabs rol pa'i 'dug steng khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa/ sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang po ral gri/ gnyis pa thod khrag g.yon dang po mdung / gnyis pa rtse gsum/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs/ ba glang gi ko bas smad g.yogs/ re lde'i sham thabs/ sbrul gyi ske rags/ spyan gsum pa/ mi ro khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul/ g.yon pa la seṅge dkar po ral pa dmar ser yod pa/ sku la khrag zhag thal chen rnams mtshon byed tsam/ shin tu rid pa lte ba'i thad du nyi zla rnams bri/ rtsibs gnyis pa la nag po gnod sbyin zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gser gyi gri gug g.yon thod khrag dar nag gi na bza'/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon pa/ gser gyi rna cha can/ rtsibs gsum pa la nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi spu gri/ g.yon thod khrag byu ru'i lan tshar dang / dar nag gi na bza' can/ rtsibs bzhi pa la dam can pu tra zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri/ g.yon thod khrag dar gyi aṅga rag dkar po/ dar nag gi na bza'/ dar men dmar po'i ga zha byas pa/ rtsibs lnga pa la bha ṭa stag slog gyon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gsang ba'i dam shiing phur bu zhal gsum yod pa/ g.yon mi'i snying 'dzin pa/ rtsibs drug pa la sring mo khrag mig ma kha nas me 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gser gyi spu gri/ g.yon mi'i rgyu ma 'dzin zhing za 'og na tri'i gos gyon pa/ lnga ka'ang sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa/ rus pa'i rgyan dang mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa'i do shal rgyu ma la rgyus pa khrag 'dzag pa bri/ lha mo phral nas 'bri mi nyan pas rtsibs drug kho na yin no/

/yi ge gsum gsum kyang dgod/ ming spel ba mi bya/ byas na gnod par 'gyur gsung ba gong 'og dkrugs te cung zad gab nas mdzad pa yang slob dpon med par dpe tsam la brten nas man ngag zab mo nyams kyi dogs pa yin/ don e ka dza ṭi sogs 'khor gyi lha bdun po'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ ste 'bru gsum po bkod pa'o/ /rtsibs bar gyi rtsa bar rdo rje sngon po langs pa re bri/ rdo rje'i steng gi rtsibs bar la yi dam gyi sngags thung / oṃ de ba pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā ces dang / mgon po'i sngags thung / oṃ mahā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i mjug tu/ e ka dza ṭis 'chang ba pa la e ka dza ṭi rang gi 'khu ldog gi gnod pa dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung cig rakṣa/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams mas 'chang ba pa la 'dod khams lha mo rang gi 'khu ldog gi gnod pa dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung cig rakṣa/ ces pa e ka dza ṭi'i g.yon gyi rtsibs bar du bri/ de bzhin du gnod sbyin yab nas sring mo'i bar gyi rtsibs bar g.yon du rim pa bzhin gong ltar rtsibs bar gnyis pa la yi dam chos skyong gi sngags thung gnyis kyi mjug tu nag po gnod sbyin gyi 'chang ba pa la nag po gnod sbyin rang gi 'khu ldog dang / mi mthun pa sogs 'dra/ rtsibs bar gsum pa la gong bzhin sngags thung gnyis dang / nag mo gnod sbyin gyis 'chang ba pa la nag mo gnod sbyin rang gi 'khu ldog dang / mi mthun pa sogs 'dra/ rtsibs bar bzhi pa la sngags thung gnyis dang / las mkhan pu tras 'chang ba pa la las mkhan pu tra rang gi 'khu ldog dang / mi mthun pa sogs 'dra/ rtsibs bar lnga pa la sngags thung gnyis dang / dam can bha ṭas 'chang ba pa la bha ṭa rang gi 'khu ldog dang / mi mthun pa sogs 'dra/ rtsibs bar drug pa la sngags thung gnyis dang / sring mo kha 'bar mas 'chang ba pa la sring mo kha 'bar ma rang gi 'khu ldog dang /

mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung cig rakṣa ces pa bri/ 'dis e ka dza ṭi la sogs pa 'khor gyi lha bdun rang la mi bzlog pa yin/ 'di la sngags mi dgos gsungs pa e ka dza ṭi sogs 'khor rang gi sngags mi bri ba yin no/ /de'i phyi'i bskor thig bzhi pa'i mu khyud la/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi rtse mo re'i thad du re'u mig re byas pa'i nang du/ e ka dza ṭi dang lha mo'i thad du phyag mtshan bum pa/ ral gri/ thod khrag gsum bri/ gnod sbyin yab kyi thad du gser gyi gri gug yum gyi thad du gser gyi spu gri/ pu tra'i thad du ral gri/ bha ṭa'i thad du dam shing phur bu zhal gsum yod pa/ sring mo'i thad du'ang gser gyi spu gri rnams bri/ lha de dag gi phyag mtshan g.yas pa kho na bri/ gnyis ka mi bri gsungs pas gzhan mi bri'o/ /kha cig gi lha mo'i phyag mtshan bzhi ka bris pa dang bum pa rkyang pa bris pa yang yong gin 'dug ste ma dag pa'o/ /phyag mtshan rnams kyi srag e ka dza ṭi dang lha mo'i phyag mtshan gyi g.yon du oṃ āḥ oṃ e ka dza ṭi de ba ind+ra si hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā hūm̐/ 'chang ba pa la e ka dza ṭis mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung cig rakṣa/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣṭha ba dho si ka ma la rakkha si hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ dpal ldan lha mo 'dod khams mas 'chang ba pa la mi mthun pa'i sogs 'dra/ gnod sbyin yab kyi phyag mtshan gyi g.yon du/ oṃ āḥ oṃ badzra kā la yakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ nag po gnod sbyin gyis 'chang ba pa la mi mthun pa'i sogs 'dra/ gnod sbyin yum gyi phyag mtshan gyi g.yon du/ oṃ āḥ oṃ badzra kā li yakṣi ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ nag mo gnod sbyin gyis 'chang ba pa la mi mthun pa'i sogs 'dra/ pu tra'i phyag mtshan gyi g.yon du oṃ āḥ oṃ badzra yakṣa pu tra hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ las mkhan pu tras 'chang ba pa la mi mthun pa'i sogs 'dra/ bha ṭa'i phyag mtshan gyi g.yon du oṃ āḥ

oṃ badzra ru dra bha ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ dam can bha ṭas 'chang ba pa la mi mthun pa'i sogs 'dra/ sring mo'i phyag mtshan gyi g.yon du oṃ āḥ oṃ badzra ru lu rakkha si hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ sring mo kha 'bar mas 'chang ba pa la mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung cig rakṣa/ ces pa thams cad la 'dra bar phyag mtshan srag gi mu khyud la bri/ 'dis sngags mi bzlog go /'di bzhin bri ba yang / 'khor bdun gyi sngags dang spel ba bris la sbyar ba so so'i skabs ma nor bar bya ba yin no/ /zhes gong du gsungs pa ltar bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan pa yin no/ /de'i phyir bskor thig lnga pa'i mu khyud la/ las mgon pho mo'i bod rbad gnyis bri gsungs pas/ mos pho bskul ba'i tshul gyis/ mo'i bod pa ni/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pā la a shugme ma hūm̐ ma bhyoḥdzaḥdzaḥ mo'i rbad pa ni/ traka raksha kha munt+ra ru lu ru lu/ traka raksha snying khrag snying bhyoḥ pu tra pu tra bhyoḥ sha sha traka sha sha traka traka mo tra pa sha trun mā ra ya/ pho'i bod pa ni/ oṃ a li a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ li shod ded/ a shod ded/ mu rmugs spu gri a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la rub dzaḥdzaḥ pho'i rbad pa ni/ dhṛka dhṛka ya du pa sha ni sod/ dum shig ā gatstsha/ ā gatstsha/ ya nṛ ya nṛ/ mon bu dzaḥ mon bu khrag la 'jibs dzaḥ 'chang ba pa la pha rol gyi byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad gzer gsum/ nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung cig rakṣa/ ces pa gong bzhin mu khyud khengs pa bri/ ma khengs na rakṣa mang du bris la khengs pa byed/ de'i phyi'i bskor thig drug pa'i mu khyud la/ oṃ shrī mahā kā lā ya/ shā sa no pa hi ṇe/ e ṣa/ a pashtsi ma/ kā lo ya mi daṃ/ ratna tra ya/ a pa ka ri ṇe/ ya di twaṃ/ pra tidzña/ sma ra si/ ta dā/ i daṃ/ duṣṭan/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/

ma ra ma ra/ gṛhna gṛhna/ bandha bandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'chang ba pa la sde brgyad kyi gnod pa thams cad dang / nad gdon phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad/ byad kha rbod gtong mnan gtad gzer gsum sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung cig rakṣa/ ces pa gong bzhin mu khyud khengs par bri/ 'di yan gyi sngags rnams mgo phyir bstan yin/ de'i phyi'i bskor thig bdun pa'i mu khyud la phyogs mtshams mi 'khrul ba'i phyir padma 'dab brgyad kyi rnam pa tsam bris pa la/ phyogs skyong gi spel tshig dang bcas pa yig mgo nang bstan du bris te/ pad 'dab shar la 'chang ba pa la brgya byin dang / tshangs pa'i gdon gyi gnod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa/ kha kha dus ma yin pa'i sbyor ba thams cad hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad 'dab lhor/ 'chang ba pa la gshin rje'i gdon gyi gnod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dus ma yin pa 'chi ba thams cad hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad 'dab nub la/ 'chang ba pa la chu lha dang sa lha'i gdon gyi gnod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa/ bandha bandha byad kha thams cad hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad 'dab byang la 'chang ba pa la gnod sbyin gyi gdon gyi gnod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa/ ma ra ma ra longs spyod la gnod pa thams cad hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar lho'i pad 'dab la/ 'chang ba la me lha'i gdon gyi gnod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa/ di na me ke na rims nad kyi 'chi ba thams cad hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho nub kyi pad 'dab la/ 'chang ba pa la srin po'i gdon gyi gnod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa/ da ha da ha byad stems kyi gnod pa thams cad hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub byang gi pad 'dab la/ 'chang ba pa la rlung lha'i gdon gyi gnod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa/ gṛhna gṛhna 'khor dang tshe la gnod pa thams cad hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar gyi pad 'dab la/ 'chang ba pa la dbang ldan gyi gdon gyi gnod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa/ khā hi khā hi dus ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa mu khyud khengs pa gong bzhin bri/

de'i phyi'i bskor thig brgyad pa'i mu khyud la phyogs skyong gi sku bri dgos pas/ bskor thag che ba la pad 'dab che ba brgyad bris pa'i/ shar gyi pad 'dab la/ g.yas su brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon du tshangs pa ser po ngang pa la zhon pa gdong pa bzhi pa phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar bas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho'i pad 'dab la gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas dbyug pa rtse dang rtsa ba la nor bu mig gcig pas …… dbu can gyi klad kor 'dra ba mtshan pa/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub kyi pad 'dab la g.yas su chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rje rtse gnyis su mtshan pa'i zhags pa/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon du sa'i lha mo ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma phag la zhon pa/ g.yon gser gyi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin cing / g.yas dam bca' khas len pa'i tshul gyis thugs ka'i stod du thal mo bsgreng ba/ byang gi pad 'dab la gnod sbyin ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rta la zhon pa/ g.yas dbyug pa gong bzhin/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ shar lho'i pad 'dab la me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na dbyug gu dang spyi blugs/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lho nub kyi pad 'dab la srin po nag po ro langs la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas ral gri/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang gi pad 'dab la/ rlung lha ljang khu ri dwags la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ba dan/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar gyi pad 'dab la/ dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas mdung / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa rnams las mgon bzhin zhal nang gzigs bris pa'i brgya byin gyi sku'i g.yas g.yon la yig mgo phyir bstan nas/ oṃ ind+ra ye swāhā/ 'chang ba pa la mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung cig

tshangs pa'i g.yas g.yon du/ oṃ brahma ṇa ye swāhā/ 'chang ba pa la mi mthun pa'i sogs 'dra/ gshin rje'i g.yas g.yon du oṃ ya ma ye swāhā/ 'chang ba pa la sogs 'dra/ chu lha'i g.yas g.yon du/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ye swāhā/ 'chang ba pa la sogs 'dra/ sa lha'i g.yas g.yon du/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wi swāhā/ 'chang ba la sogs 'dra/ gnod sbyin gyi g.yas g.yon du/ oṃ ku be ra ye swāhā/ 'chang ba pa la sogs 'dra/ me lha'i g.yas g.yon du/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ 'chang ba pa la sogs 'dra/ srin po'i g.yas g.yon du/ oṃ ne ri ta ye swāhā/ 'chang ba pa la sogs 'dra/ rlung lha'i g.yas g.yon du/ oṃ wa ya be swāhā/ 'chang ba pa la sogs 'dra/ dbang ldan gyi g.yas g.yon du/ oṃ i shwa na ye swāhā/ 'chang ba pa la mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung cig ces pa rnams bri'o/ /bskor thig dgu pa'i mu khyud la thod skam gyi rwa ba bar mtshams med pa 'phred bstan du bri bskor thig bcu pa'i mu khyud la rdo rje sngon po'i rwa ba bar mtshams med pa bri/ de'i phyi rol du me ri 'bar bas yongs su 'khor ba bri/ pad rwa nyis rim dang / phyogs skyong gi sku'i g.yas g.yon gyi sngags yig mgo phyir bstan yin pa padma'i rwa ba nang ma'i yi ge mgo nang du bstan pa bri gsungs pas thon no/ /phyag len du ma'i nang nas sa lo'i phyag len/ dpe bris su ma mthong na'ang sngags 'chang rgya gar shes bzang gi phyag bris mtha' btsan par byas so/ /de dag gis ni bri ba yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to// //da ni rab tu gnas par byed pa la/ thog mar bri ba'i dus rtog pa zhib cing phyag len ma nyams par zhus dag byas blor ma song ba rang yid ches/ nges shes 'grong pa grub pa rnams/ 'byung po'i nyi ma gza' skar bzang po la bskang gso sogs mchod gtor dang tshogs kyi yo byad 'byor pa dang bstun rgya che ba so so'i phyag len bzhin rten la sogs pa'i mdun du bsham/

de'i nye logs zhig tu stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du/ zangs gzhong la sogs pa'i snod bzang zhing gtsang ba gang 'byor nas 'bras sogs 'bru gtsang mas bkang ba'i steng du/ bsrung ba mang po yod na brtsegs la mgon po'i zhabs rang la bstan pa mang nyung gang yod kyang bzhugs tshul 'dra bar bzhugs su gsol/ de'i mdun du yang mchod pa chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / gtor chung gcig rang gi mdun du rdo dril nang mchod/ 'thor nas/ sbyang chas spyi 'gro rnams bshams/ de nas rang stan la 'dug ste/ yi dam gang byed kyi bdag bskyed dam/ lam dus byung na 'brel che zhing legs/ yang myur bar dgos na/ mgon po'i bsrung 'khor rgyas bsdus gang rung bsgom la rang ngam/ las slobs kyi bsrung ba rnams gu gul gyi bdug sbyang ba rnams sbyang stan gyi steng du bsrung ba la kha bstan nas bzhag gtor ma chus sbyangs/ ting lo sbar la/ gtor ma sogs bsrung ba rnams la bskor zhing / na maḥsarba sogs kyi zhi ba/ ting lo dang chang bu bsgrags pas bskor zhing sumbha ni brjod pa sogs zhi drag phyed ma/ khro bo spyan 'dren/ bstod pa sogs byas nas/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa sogs rab gnas spyi dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par/ 'dir rdo rje nag po chen po'i rang bsrung zab mo rab tu gnas pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ gu gul gyis bdug yung dkar gyi brabs/ sumbha ni sogs drag sngags brjod/ rol mo'i sgra cher byas pa drag po'i sbyang ba'o/ /de nas rdo rjes nang mchod nas bsrung ba rnams la 'thor tshul byas la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du thod pa mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su gnam lcags las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar padma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ mthing nag gi mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs bdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po sogs nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar dang / rtsibs dang por traṃ las e ka dza ṭi ces pa nas hūm̐ dang bhyo'i sgra sgrogs pa'i bar lha mo sogs bskyed/ rtsibs gnyis par ya las nag po gnod sbyin/ rtsibs gsum par maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin/ rtsibs bzhi par tri las pu tra/ rtsibs lnga par tri las bha ṭa/ rtsibs drug par bhyoḥlas sring mo sogs dang / gzhan yang g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya nas/ pho nya bsam gyi mi khyab pas bskor ba/ ces pa'i bar gtor bsngo ltar rgyas par bskyed/ gsung yig 'bru'i sngags dang / thugs phyag mtshan rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las gsung yig 'bru'i sngags rnams pad nyi'i steng du āḥlas padma āḥyis mtshan pa las gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas padma/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag mtshan rnams stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

dar dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyi rol du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad la/ phyogs skyongs bcu po so so'i sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa phyogs mtshams brgyad du bzhugs par gyur/ nang gi sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams kyi dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma'i steng dang āḥdamar po/ thugs khar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo/ las kyi mgon po la bka' bstod pho nya'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ 'od dpag med/ mi bskyod pa dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ mgon po kun gshegsྎ lha mo kun gshegsྎ las mgon kun gshegs sogs sngags dang bcas pas gtor bsngo sngags dang bcas pa gtor bsngo bzhin dang / ma lus sems can kun gyi shlau ka gcig brjod/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyi mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mang du brjod la bstim/ lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ thugs khar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas nam mkha' gang ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /sogs spyi ltar lan gsum brjod la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbastim pa gong bzhin/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badzra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ oṃ badzrī bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las thams cad la rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu brgyan/

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wi ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyi mchod/ gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal/ /sogs shlau ka gcig dang / phyag byar 'os pa sogs kyis bstod/ spyan dbye ni/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du rdo rje bzung la/ spyan dbye ba'i tshul bya zhing / kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan sogs sngags bcas kyi mjug tu/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing sems can gyi don dang / khyad par du yang 'chang ba pa la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung ba'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur gcig ces lan gsum brjod/ brtan bzhugs ni/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bsdus pa cig byas la/ ye dharma lan gsum brjod pas 'thor nas byin gyis brlab par bsam pa'i me tog nas lag tu bzung nas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs 'dra ba la brtan par bzhugs nas 'chang ba pa la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung zhing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ye swahā/ yang yang brjod cing me tog gi char dbab bo/ /de ltar lan gsum byas la/ gtor chung sbyangs nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥbyin rlabs bsdus pa byas te/ mgon po kun gshegs sogs kyi spyan drang nas sngags bsngos tsam byas la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā ka li de wi ye sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ pā dyaṃ nas shapda'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ āoṃ shrī ma hā sogs gong bzhin mtshan sngags la oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod phul la/ srin gzugs ma sogs mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas kyi bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang shes dang / rdo rje'i gsung ni dpag med pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung mchog dpal/ /rdo rje'i gsung ni kun 'byung ba/

/rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje'i thugs ni bla na med/ /skye med spros bral ngo bo nyid/ /mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /sogs kyis bstod la/ de ba pi tsu nyer gcig mgon po'i yi ge bdun ma brgya rtsa/ bcu gnyis ma/ sha sa na/ e ka dza ṭa'i/ oṃ e ka dza ṭi de ba ind+ra si hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ces dang / lha mo la ro ru/ las mgon gyi bod rbad gnyis rnams nyer gcig re bzlas la/ gong bzhin phyi nang gi mchod nas/ sa skya'i bka' bsrung mthu rtsal can khyed rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyong / khyad par du yang 'chang ba pa la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad mi 'byung ba'i 'phrin las dang stong grogs mdzod cig ces brjod/ zhal bsgyur ni/ lha brgyad dang phyogs skyong rnams mi bsgyur/ 'od dpag med zhu ba las ā li kā li'i rang bzhin gsung yig 'bru'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ mi bskyod pa zhu ba las thugs phyag mtshan so so'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod nas rten 'brel snying po gsum bzlas la/ bla ma yi dam chos bsrung nor lha'i bkra shis gang shes brjod/ nyin mo bde legs kyi mjug tu/ su pra tiṣṭha dang / oṃ hūṃ hrīḥbhrūṃ khaṃ badzrī bhā wa dri dha tiṣṭha bhu khaṃ swāhā/ ces mang du brjod/ rol mo bya/ nas sogs gtor/ long yod cing shes shing spro na gong du bshad pa ltar bskang gso ji ltar rigs pa gtor bsngo rgyas pa dang bcas pa/ tshogs 'khor so so'i phyag len bzhin 'di'i skabs su byed/ yang rgyu ma 'dzoms pa dang / byed par mi spro na ma byas kyang chad pas skyon med do/ /de nas bsrung ba rnams ltab/ mgo gsham ma log pa dbu phyogs dang rgyab mdun la rtags rgyab/ srad bu nag pos rgya gram du gang shong dkri ba'am/

dkris shes na nag po gtso che ba'i sna lnga dar skud sogs gang 'byor gyis legs par lag len gyi thon pa byas la/ gri snying gi rtsa dbu mar bcug gsungs kyang mi thub/ gri snying gi ko lpags mnyes pas gril/ mgo mjug mi log pa'i rtags byas la mi lpags kyi khug mar bcug nas gri lcags kyi ga'u 'am/ shing gi ga'u gru bzhi ran par bzos la rngul gyi skyon mi yong bar byas te/ lus dang ma bral bar gdags/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pas mthong thos ma byung ba gal che'o/ /de ltar byas pas phan yon bar chad thams cad bzlog cing / khyad par chos skyong rang dang 'bral med bzhugs nas 'khu ldog mi 'byung zhing gnod 'tshe kun bsrung ba'i mchog yin no/ /gri snying ma 'byor na zhing chen gyi khug ma/ de yang ma 'byor na dar nag la sha sa na bris pas gril bas chog dam tshig bla ma dang / nag po chen po la mos pa/ gsang dam pa/ gtor ma chag tsam 'bul thub na bzang / mi shes na bzod/ lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang ma thob pa la mi gdags/ rjes gnang thob phyin bsrung 'khor rgyas pa'i bsrung ba 'di 'bral med 'dogs pa gnad du che/ gong gi bsrung ba'i spel tshig la 'chang ba pa la zer ba pho mo gang la btags kyang yong ba'i phyed dang / bsrung ba mang po yod na ming nor dogs yin/ gcig lta bu yin na/ 'chang ba pa 'di zhes ming bcug pas yong / tshon gtong dus sku rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru gsum dang / khyad par gtso bo'i sku gsung thugs kyi yig 'bru rnams la tshon byug gsung na'ang / sku byin la tshon thob gang yod byas/ yi ge'i thad du mdang lta bu'i yig 'bru mngon tsam bya'o// //dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i rang bsrung rgyas pa'i man ngag bram ze mchog sred nas brgyud pa/ 'di'i lung man ngag rnams rje brtse ba chen po sa skya pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug kun dga' snying po nas rim gyis brgyud de/ 'khon ston rgya gar shes bzang las sa lo chen pos gsan/

de'i zhabs la gus pas btugs shing / gzhan yang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor grub chen dpal ldan bkra shis/ mkhas pa'i dbang po ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ sems dpa' chen po spyan snga ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa rnams la zhus shing dges bzhin du gnang ste kun dang thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag zab mo khong nang gi khrag lta bu gab 'khrugs cung zad tsam med pa bri ba'i skabs ma yin mod/ 'on kyang snyigs dus kyis sems can skal ba dman pas 'di phyi'i mi bsam pa'i bdud sprul zog chos mkhan rnams kyi don gang yang mi shes/ man ngag ma thob kyang ham pa kho nas skye bo rnams bslus te rang gi rnyed pa tshol phyir phan med gnyis phung bya phyir/ bsrung ba ma dag pa bri zhing 'dogs pa dang / bris pa rnying pa mang po mthong bas rkyen byas snying nas ma bzod/ dpe gsal ba 'di dang 'phrad na/ bla ma la btugs pa sogs kyi rnam dbye go ste/ nor 'khrul med pa'i sgo nas sems can la phan du re ba kho nas sa lo chen po'i phyag len mthong ba bzhin cung zad kyang ma sbas par gsal bar bkod pa 'di ni/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis me 'bar ma sogs yig rnying dang / bsrung dpe rgya gar sher bzang gi phyag bris ma la zhib tu btugs shing / sa lo sogs kyi phyag len gyi brgyan nas/ bla ma dang bka' bsrung la gsol ba btab ste/ dben gnas byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du rigs kyi bu spun dang / bstan 'gro la bsam nas sug bris bgyis pa la ma rig pa'i dbang gis nyes pa mchis pa rnams/ bla ma sa lo chen po dang ma hā kā la 'khor bcas kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol// //rdo rje 'chang mtshungs rje btsun gong ma yis/ /shin tu gsang ba'i man ngag zab don rnams/

/ham can rang dgar 'jug pa spangs pa'i phyir/ /gab cing tho tsam mdzad pas go dka' yang / /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir ding sang bdud sprul gyis/ /ma go bzhin du rang gzhan mgo bskor nas/ /zog chos bsre lhad du mas skye bo bslu/ /tshe 'dir bar chad rkyen gyi lus sems mnar/ /phyi ma ngan song bsgrub pa'i las byed la/ /snying rje skyes te cung zad phan re nas/ /bla ma'i gdams pa snying nang khrag lta bu/ /yi ger bris pa sa los bzod par mdzod/ /man ngag ma thob lag len ma bslab pa/ /gnyis phung ma bsgrub bsam mno legs par thongs/ /phyi rab bsrung 'khor bri ba'i blo yod rnams/ /dam pa bsten las zab don lung sogs nos/ /'chol par spyod pa'i mi dge'i bshes gnyen spongs/ /bslu ba med pa'i man ngag yang thig zung / /shes tshe lag len rtog zhib byas gyur na/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur thob 'gyur/ /'di bris dge bas phyi nang bdud sde las/ /rnam par rgyal te bar chad kun bsal nas/ /bdag sogs 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyang / /rje btsun sa lo'i zhabs drung skye bar shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 14 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ rang srung rgyas pa 'bri tshul shin tu gsal ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
